findings.label: SERVICE_CATEGORY not keyed to SERVICE_OPTIONS
findings.detail: SERVICE_CATEGORY is typed `Record<string, "developer" | "media">` independently of the SERVICE_OPTIONS array, and tsconfig has no `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`, so TypeScript treats `SERVICE_CATEGORY[anyKey]` as always defined. A service added to SERVICE_OPTIONS without a matching category entry compiles, but at runtime `team.filter((m) => m.category === undefined)` returns [] and the Anggota dropdown renders empty with no type error. All 9 current services are mapped, so this is a latent maintainability gap, not a current bug.
findings.action: Type the map as `Record<(typeof SERVICE_OPTIONS)[number], "developer" | "media">` (or derive SERVICE_OPTIONS from `Object.keys(SERVICE_CATEGORY)`) so a missing mapping becomes a compile error instead of a silent empty dropdown.

findings.label: Optional selects can't be cleared
findings.detail: Both the Jasa and Anggota Tim selects use `<option value="" disabled>` as their placeholder, so once a value is chosen the user can only switch to another option, never back to the empty/none state — even though both fields are labeled optional.
findings.action: Drop `disabled` on the placeholder option (or add an explicit re-selectable "— Tidak ada —" option) if clearing an optional selection should be possible.
